claims.statement: Tom Allen fought Charley Gallagher in St. Louis a few years before 1886.
claims.excerpt: Charley C. Gallagher, who fought Tom Alien here a few years ago.

fights.excerpt: Charley C. Gallagher, who fought Tom Alien here a few years ago.
fights.notes: Only mention is Captain Dalton's remark; no date or result given. Place is inferred from 'here' (the paper is St. Louis).

notes: Allen appears only as Gallagher's opponent in Dalton's interview; the rest concerns Dalton and Jack King.
